data.name: war crowning and bleeding animals
data.detailed_description:
"War, Crown and Bleeding Animals" is a story-driven RPG adventure game from a female perspective. Players will take on the role of a protagonist embroiled in power struggles and write their own destiny in a kingdom full of conspirations and choices.

The game immerses players in an epic story about ambition, morality and governance through rich narratives, exploration and puzzle-solving, and strategic dialogues. In the game, players need to navigate among various forces, influence the plot's direction through crucial decisions, and uncover the secrets behind the kingdom. You can explore exquisite hand-drawn style scenes, solve carefully designed puzzles, and interact with numerous characters with distinct personalities - their fates will change because of your choices.

Is it to ascend the throne and become the eternal ruler? Or break the shackles and lead the kingdom towards an unknown future? Every decision made by the player will trigger a profound chain reaction.

The game features multiple story branches and endings, ensuring that every play brings a different experience.

The unique female perspective narrative, in-depth character development, and some exclusive original soundtracks jointly create a fantasy world full of emotions and tension. If you enjoy themes driven by plot, moral choices, and power struggles, then "War, Crown, and Bleeding Animals" will bring you an unforgettable adventure.
